sites.ownership: The reader unit-test thread owns one temporary chunk-size override.
sites.justification: Serial task tests force multiple real Gio reads so cancellation and short-read continuation are deterministic; the RAII hook clears the thread-local override after each test.

sites.ownership: The reader unit-test thread owns one temporary byte-read observer.
sites.justification: The observer counts bytes returned by real Gio reads and proves an oversized worktree file stops at the checked sentinel; the RAII hook removes it after the callback settles.

sites.ownership: The reader unit-test thread owns one temporary stream-close observer.
sites.justification: The observer receives the real FileInputStream closed state after uncancelled close completion, proving success and cancellation release the owned stream exactly once.

sites.ownership: Each review-loader test owns its callback counter on one thread-default main context.
sites.justification: The counter verifies bounded success, overflow, cancellation and read errors each settle the loader continuation once before the test returns.
